blurb: Captain Gregg Fishing Charters offers fishing trips in Sarasota, Florida, focusing on customer service and safety. They teach guests, including children, how to fish and about different species. Trips explore Sarasota Bay and offshore fishing in the Gulf of Mexico.
extraNote: Most charters leave from either Hart’s Landing Marina or 10th Street Ramp near downtown Sarasota.
